stories.headline: Bella Ramsey’s Cutout Top Might Be Their Boldest Look Yet - E! News
stories.summary: The Last of Us star Bella Ramsey dared to bare in a bib cardigan by Miu Miu that featured cutouts on the sides. See their custom-made look.
stories.why: Ramsey, non-binary star of HBO's biggest show, is normalizing gender-fluid fashion in mainstream spaces—this isn't niche anymore, it's what prestige TV talent wears to red carpets.

stories.headline: Behind the Scenes of Obama’s Acting Cameo in ‘Life, Larry’: Blaming Larry David for His Tan Suit Debacle, Improvising Lines and Ranting About Ketchup - Variety
stories.summary: Barack Obama has an acting cameo in Larry David's new HBO Show 'Life, Larry and the Pursuit of Unhappiness,' blaming David for the tan suit debacle.
stories.why: Obama doing comedy signals the post-presidency memeing of politics is complete; he's leaning into cultural moments (tan suit) that defined internet discourse, showing how politics and entertainment have fully merged.

stories.headline: What’s next for Chelsea Green, Tiffany Stratton - Cageside Seats
stories.summary: We found the new direction for the women’s champion and the United States champion on SmackDown in Philly.
stories.why: Women's wrestling main event talent is getting storyline prominence on WWE's flagship show—tracking where booking goes tells you WWE's real priorities for female talent revenue.

stories.headline: John Goodman, 74, Looks Unrecognizable After 200-Pound Weight Loss in New Photo - E! News
stories.summary: John Goodman was nearly unrecognizable in a new picture with Wizards of Waverly Place actor David DeLuise due to the 200-pound weight loss transformation he’s undergone since the aughts.
stories.why: Goodman's transformation at 74 reframes what's possible for older male actors in terms of physicality and screen presence; he's competing for roles differently than the version most men remember.

stories.headline: The CM Punk/Kevin Owens verbal war begins - Cageside Seats
stories.why: Punk vs. Owens is WWE's attempt to manufacture the kind of organic beef that defined wrestling's most profitable eras—watch if the company can actually build compelling narrative tension in 2024.

stories.headline: Influencer Ash Trevino Allegedly Had Relationships With 50-75 Inmates - TMZ
stories.summary: Prosecutors say influencer Ash Trevino had relationships with over 50 inmates -- including ones in prison for aggravated robbery and murder -- over the past several years ... TMZ has learned.
stories.why: This isn't celebrity scandal—it's a real criminal investigation that exposes how influencer parasocial power operates with no guardrails, particularly around vulnerable populations.

stories.headline: 'RHOA' Star Porsha Williams Scores Big in Divorce Battle, Gets Multimillion-Dollar Home - TMZ
stories.summary: Huge win for Porsha Williams ... she scored a seven-figure divorce settlement and the house from her ex Simon Guobadia ... and she told a judge he agreed to quickly pay up the other money he owes, TM…
stories.why: Williams securing seven figures and assets signals the financial stakes in high-profile divorces are finally reflecting women's earning power, not just splitting what men built.

stories.headline: Brittany Boltinhouse says Miss NC USA title was taken because of her beliefs - ABC11 News
stories.summary: Boltinhouse said she believes her title was "ripped" away because of her conservative Christian views.
stories.why: A pageant contestant claiming ideological censorship connects to broader culture-war narrative; her claim matters less than whether pageant organizations face real pressure from either side.
